data.one_liner: Fast, zero-dependency CSV parser, encoder, streamer, and query engine for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Decodes and encodes RFC 4180 CSV, TSV, and custom-delimited data with automatic type inference, chunked streaming, and schema validation. Provides a CsvTable layer for filtering, sorting, grouping, and aggregating tabular data.
use_when: You need to parse, stream, or write CSV files efficiently in Dart or Flutter
You want automatic type inference for numbers, booleans, and dates without external dependencies
You need to query, transform, and validate tabular CSV data using a DataFrame-style API
avoid_when: You are working with full Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheet files rather than plain text CSV
You require built-in localized month names for date parsing in languages other than English
strengths: Zero dependencies and pure Dart implementation supporting all platforms
High performance with constant-memory streaming for large files
Rich feature set including schema validation, type inference, and table querying operations
weaknesses: Does not include built-in localized month names for date parsing outside of English without manual configuration
